technique_name: Describe the similarities and differences between two art styles.
description: Impressionism and Expressionism are two of the most influential art movements of the 19th and 20th centuries. They both sought to capture and evoke emotion as opposed to relying solely on realism. Impressionists focused on capturing a fleeting moment in time and expressing their emotional reaction to their environment, often by using a visible brushstroke to capture the light and atmosphere.
